title: Subjunctive and formal structures
grammar: Subjunctive, It is essential that, I would rather

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn formal structures with the subjunctive and expressions like It is essential that, I would rather.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. It is essential that he be informed. I would rather you did not smoke here. She insisted that we stay. Notice the base form of the verb after these structures.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: It is important that she ___ on time.
phases.explanation: Subjunctive uses the base form: be, not is.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 formal recommendations for a job application using It is essential/important that.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: I would rather you ___ tell anyone.
phases.explanation: I would rather + past simple for present/future wishes.
